title: Validation run index line
description: One line of a validation run index: what one subject measured in one hardware session, in a form two sessions can be compared in. tools/validation/validation_index.py derives a line from the files a run recorded and never from prose; a value that was not measured is absent from `metrics`, never zero.

run_id.description: <date>-<row>-<subject>, with a suffix when a session ran the subject more than once. Unique in an index.

session.description: The hardware session the run belongs to. Lines of one session share it.

family_build.description: The commit the speech runtime family was built from, when it was built on the host.

subject.description: What was run: lifecycle, doctor, or a candidate's name.

kind.description: evidence: filed publicly. validation: a rolling pass, filed nowhere public.

result.description: The record's own status, never re-labelled.

metrics.description: Numbers, with the unit as the key's suffix (_ms, _s, _mib).

checks.description: Each named check's outcome as recorded.

settings.description: Anything that makes the run not comparable with a default install.

raw.description: The raw capture archive, or local-only until it is stored.
